findings_and_reconciliations.trace: Current CLI has a reusable default output directory; startup creates it and removes only four report files, leaving PNGs. Each screenshot callback chooses the planned view/path, calls the native save observer then advances without a persisted outcome; Bevy 0.19.1 returns a unit observer and only logs conversion, format and native save errors. The report checks each planned screenshot path exists and is nonempty, then includes all_artifacts_written in the acceptance conjunction. P17 has the same relevant callback/invalidation/metadata shape, while the original 059 record described historical current-main 7a9 source and a separate root L1 read used e275; neither is claimed to be 95e.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: If a prior nonempty same-name PNG remains and the new screenshot callback fails before replacing it, e.g. the native image conversion fails before disk write, the per-artifact metadata check can still see the old file. A completed capture, an actual conversion failure or a whole report passing every independent gate is not observed. Native disk writing inside the callback is synchronous; no asynchronous disk race is claimed. Other report trace/manifest/HTML errors can still fail explicitly.
findings_and_reconciliations.direction: A future owning capture authority should retain a per-run result or other proven fresh-write receipt for each requested view before completion; preserve underlying image/format/I/O cause, legitimate output reuse and unrelated files. Exact alias to CONT08 and other viewer families needs central review.

findings_and_reconciliations.classification: Comparison and independently verified limitation, not a blanket new false-pass finding.
findings_and_reconciliations.trace: P17 stores explicit Observation with Measured/Unavailable/NotApplicable for many metrics; only NotApplicable exempts the when_applicable helper, while Unavailable fails it. Current retains raw scalar metrics and optional raw clearance. Both plan completeness checks compare cardinality, scenario/frame IDs and required bone presence, and both finite bone checks cover bone positions and quaternion components only. Neither check alone establishes terrain clearance, root/body arrays, unit quaternion, frame chronology, global trace validity or producer completeness. Current quality percentage is calculated from a defect subset and completeness separately from acceptance_passed.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: Other metric, capture, plan, validation and output gates may validate or reject these values; selected scenario semantics, producer reachability and valid zero versus unavailable need independent source tracing. No unsupported raw value or complete passing report is asserted.
findings_and_reconciliations.direction: For every required observation, resolve its producer, units/frame, applicability, numeric admission and exact consumer policy; preserve separate plan, finite, artifact, validation and quality contracts. Do not replace all geometry arrays, scores or native serializer strings solely by their types.

nonfindings: Filesystem/trace/HTML write failures have explicit panic or error exit paths; the screenshot persistence finding is not a claim that every I/O failure is silently successful.
Report plan cardinality plus exact scenario/frame identities and required bones narrow a blanket missing-bone suspicion; they do not certify other observations.
P17 optional observation and native event strings represent explicit status and leaf serialization; neither is automatically a compatibility shim.
A quality percentage and acceptance_passed represent different facts; high score alone is not a claim that the acceptance conjunction succeeded.
open_questions: Can a real supported capture produce image conversion failure or other pre-replacement error while the same output directory contains a previous same-name image, and how should error causes reach the report?
What is the exact relationship of q206 to CONT08 and other screenshot families, and which owner should retain per-run proof?
What are all private screenshot map consumers and the intended native JSON/HTML representation if CaptureView remains typed internally?
What enforces nonempty planned cohorts, sample chronology, valid body/root frames, unit quaternions, and separate global trace coverage before report acceptance?
How do quality, height/landing and terrain observation policies distinguish absent, invalid, zero and nonapplicable in each selected scenario?

thirteen_lens_perspectives.bounded_assessment: Required IK weights have an explicit pair-or-error API in both revisions; raw root/scene, quaternion and clearance admission require producer-specific analysis.

Capture completeness compares the requested frame cohort and required bone presence; artifact freshness, finite geometry, frame order and observation availability are additional independent relationships.

P17 observation distinctions and current native output format differ; preserve legitimate NotApplicable, explicit error/exit and independent gates without assuming historical source is the installed solution.
P17 custom scalar serialization preserves units; do not mechanically derive or replace serialization that would change JSON representation or unchecked construction.
CaptureView owns three alternatives; independent quality defect flags and separate measured/unavailable/not-applicable are not one mutually exclusive outcome.
CaptureView already owns retained view identity in q545; SignedLength and typed observations in P17 are historical candidates, requiring exact current boundary/consumer review.
Signed geometry and finite derivations require source-specific checks; existing bounded weighted-score math and independent acceptance are not automatically an overflow or redundancy defect.
The quality score denominator is a documented aggregate bound and separate semantics from measured metric thresholds; no replacement of independent acceptance oracles follows.
Historical q545 identifies typed view lost before private lookup; wire labels, native filenames, diagnostic strings and serialization labels are different boundaries.
Current request path → screenshot callback → unit native save → retained names → artifact metadata → acceptance is traced; actual capture, failure and full report outcomes remain unobserved.
A filesystem existence/length observation cannot independently certify that this run wrote the requested image; preserve this first contract separate from view-key propagation.
Elapsed time, scene/body positions, clearance, quaternion, root distance, screenshot view and status have different units, frames and existence conditions.
Capture persistence owns acknowledgment, CaptureView owns view identity, native filesystem owns pathname and format, and report acceptance owns conjunction; exact repair and aliases remain central.

limitations: Source inspection and evidence integrity only; no repairs, builds, tests, viewer, screenshots, runtime probes, simulations or product validation.
Historical original receipts, summaries and registered native reads retain their revision and authors; no checkpoint3821 reconstruction or read transfer.
Central agent owns exact alias decisions, ordered coverage, connected ledger and publication.
